subject: PROFILE: per-miss breakdown base vs fold (host, 142-record corpus); after the fold the AIR translator is 86% and 1/3 of it is avoidable waste
body: Tool: LD_PRELOAD shim (stage CPU timing + 1ms SIGPROF sampler + Mali input capture) on pipeline-pack-20261026/c6k replay, NIR_DEBUG=novalidate as on device, thread-CPU ms. Files: gpu/build/compile-speed-20261026/{tools,bin,runs}. BASE (compile-stall lib-base): air_create 88.0 ms/pipeline, mali_options 67.2 (fs>100K 76.8 x123, small 4.7 x19), serialize 2.4. Mali base split (fixed_frag dominated): translate_specialized 47% (spirv_to_nir 24%, vars_to_ssa 15%), lower_generic_resources fold loop 31%, select_generic_output vars_to_ssa 15%, compile_stage (pan_preprocess+backend+RA) only 5%: i.e. 95% walks dead uber-shader code, exactly what ansuz rottenapple_nm fixed with an early cheap fold/DCE loop (their 157->67 ms). FOLD (lib-fold-dev, encode's const_loads + Device cache): air_create 21.3 ms, mali_options 3.5 ms, serialize 0.1 => ~25 ms/miss host (was ~157). Post-fold Mali is a normal compile (bi_optimize_loop 29%, nir_opt_algebraic 21%, RA 12%, pan_preprocess 15%); NOT worth NDEBUG risk (Mali is now 14% of a miss). Post-fold AIR (translator) split: specialize_dynamic/sccp 54%, air::decode of the function bitcode on EVERY pipeline 25% (specialize_one -> air::decode, no reuse across pipelines of the same function), DeviceProfile::fingerprint() recomputed per compile 8.4% (Debug-format of all profile fields into SHA-256, plan_one key::function_key), container::sha256(bitcode) 2.3%, emit 3%. Proposal (translator side-copy patches, exactness-preserving, to hand to encode/root): (1) per-process decode cache keyed by the already-computed air_hash (clone of Decoded), (2) fingerprint memo validated by ProfileFields equality (tests mutate profiles, so no address-keyed memo), (3) Rust release LTO/codegen-units=1 for the bridge (panic=abort NOT safe: air_bridge.rs uses catch_unwind). Device miss distinct keys: 108/108 Mali misses in c6l ui350 are distinct keys; 32 share the same vs/fs SPIR-V sizes (2852/593516) => differ only in generic spec tables; I will check whether a VS-stage memo (fixed_vert is identical across all fixed_frag pipelines) is exact and worth it. Next: build side-copy translator with (1)+(2) and LTO when the heavy lease is free (someone is running run_host_tests now; I wait).
